verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an agentic-commerce platform, but the evidence shows no way to do it. The core services (Store Sync, PayPal Shopping Cart, the remote MCP server at mcp.paypal.com, and Braintree processing) are PayPal-hosted and form-gated. The open-source agent toolkit and the merchant-hosted cart endpoints are client-side building blocks, not a self-hostable deployment of the product itself.
